note: Manufacturer UDS knowledge map: which CAN addresses hold modules, which DID neighbourhoods hold real data, and which DIDs are already identified, keyed by VIN WMI. Researched from primary open-source sources (OVMS, wican-fw, OBDb, CanZE, opendbc, EVNotiPi) plus this project's own verified reads; see docs/uds/uds-map-research.md for per-brand provenance, confidence and gaps. Editing this file needs no code change: the discovery engine reads every per-brand value from here.

standard.note: ISO 14229-1 identification block — genuinely universal, the one part of UDS as standard as OBD PIDs. Kept here rather than in code so every value the engine uses lives in one queryable place.

address_scan.note: Conventional 11-bit physical addressing: request 0x700-0x7F6, response = request + 8. 7DF is the functional broadcast, excluded.
